info.name: Voice Agent API
info.description:
HTTP APIs for the AI Voice Agent backend (KAN-21, KAN-72 appointments).

Import with `postman/Local.postman_environment.json`.
Keep this collection in sync when adding routes — see `docs/process/POSTMAN.md`.

Do not store API keys or secrets here; the server reads them from env via `getConfig()`.

request.description: Liveness check for local/Docker verification.

Convert browser-captured audio to text (KAN-11, KAN-24 multilingual).

Optional `languageHint`: en | hi | hinglish (or ISO tags). Hinglish leaves Whisper language unset for auto-detect. Response may include provider `language`.

Replace `audioBase64` with a real base64 audio clip for a live success run.

response.name: Success — 200 OK

body.raw:
{
  "prompt": "Hi, what are your clinic hours?",
  "messages": [],
  "includeSystemPrompt": true,
  "enableTools": false,
  "language": "en"
}

request.description:
Run one LLM conversation turn (KAN-12 / KAN-25).

Provide `prompt` and/or `messages`. Optional `language` (en | hi | hinglish) sets reply-language instructions in the system prompt.

response.name: Success — 200 OK

request.description:
Convert assistant reply text to playable audio (KAN-13 / KAN-26).

Optional `language` (en | hi | hinglish) selects default voice (alloy / nova). Explicit `voice` overrides.
Start a durable conversation session (KAN-15/KAN-28). Creates `calls` + `conversation_states` + CALL_STARTED. `language` optional (default `en`); allowed: en | hi | hinglish.
List recent sessions for Call History (KAN-18).
Estimated POC OpenAI spend so far (KAN-18). Not a live wallet balance.

response.name: Success — 200 OK
response.body:
{
  "currency": "USD",
  "estimatedUsdTotal": 0,
  "turnCount": 0,
  "callCount": 0,
  "note": "Estimated POC spend from tracked OpenAI usage events; not a live OpenAI wallet balance."
}

request.description: Load session snapshot (state + turn messages for LLM context).
List call_events for a session (KAN-18 pipeline logs).
Append a turn. User text auto-detects wait/resume (KAN-15).
Explicit wait: ACTIVE → USER_REQUESTED_WAIT → WAITING_FOR_USER + WAIT_STARTED.
Resume after wait: CALLER_RETURNED → ACTIVE_CONVERSATION + CALLER_RETURNED event.
Complete session: CALL_COMPLETED + CALL_ENDED.

Orchestrated STT → language detection → session language persist → session context → LLM → TTS (KAN-14/KAN-15/KAN-23/KAN-28). Pass `callId` from POST /api/sessions for durable context. Clear detection updates session `language` (en|hi|hinglish) and response includes top-level `language`. Optional `languageHint` does not override the transcript.

response.name: Success — 200 OK
response.body:
{
  "transcript": "I need an appointment",
  "replyText": "I can help you schedule.",
  "audioBase64": "<base64-mpeg>",
  "mimeType": "audio/mpeg",
  "conversationId": "<uuid>",
  "callId": "<uuid>",
  "action": "continue",
  "currentState": "ACTIVE_CONVERSATION",
  "languageDetection": {
    "language": "en",
    "confidence": 0.92,
    "unclear": false,
    "unsupported": false
  },
  "language": "en",
  "languageChanged": false
}
